name: Mencius (Mengzi)
shortBio: Foremost classical successor to Confucius, revered as the 'Second Sage', who argued for the innate goodness of human nature and defended moral governance through benevolence rather than tyranny.
centralQuestion: Is human nature inherently predisposed toward goodness, like water naturally flowing downward, requiring only moral cultivation to blossom?

keyWorks.title: Mengzi (The Works of Mencius)
keyWorks.description: Dialogue exploring human nature, ethical cultivation (ren and yi), righteous governance, and the four sprouts of virtue.
